inputs.caption:
Global Metadata: Minimal Japanese art-pop, 96 BPM, A minor. A small, intimate 20-second verse-to-chorus arc, wistful but quietly hopeful, late-night city rain mood.

Vocal Details: Soft androgynous Japanese lead vocal, close-mic and breathy, clear diction, lightly doubled only on the final phrase. No spoken dialogue.

Arrangement: Warm felt piano, rounded bass, brushed electronic kick, soft rim-click snare, subtle tape hiss, one glassy synth line. Start with piano alone, bring in the beat under the verse, open the harmony on the short chorus, end on a gentle unresolved piano note. Compact intro, verse, chorus, no long instrumental tail.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Rain draws a map across the glass
Neon rivers slowly pass
I keep one small light awake
For the morning we will make

[Chorus]
Even in the blue hour, we begin again
